This promotion (“LOTTO”) is operated solely by AstroLexis LLC (“PyBLØCK”). Contact: contact@astrolexis.space. Apple Inc. is not a sponsor of, is not involved in, and is not responsible for LOTTO in any way.

PyBLØCK is a Bitcoin mining pool. When hash rate is directed to the LOTTO pool, it participates in solo-style block discovery on the Bitcoin network. If a block is found, the block reward is distributed to eligible participants by a publicly verifiable weighted draw (Efraimidis–Spirakis), seeded by the previous block hash, in proportion to the proof-of-work contributed. Outcomes are probabilistic and depend on real network mining. No outcome is guaranteed.

No payment is required to participate. You may direct your own mining hardware to the LOTTO pool at no cost to PyBLØCK and be entered on the same basis as any other participant. Any in-app hash rate purchase pays for a real, off-device compute service (mining) and is not a wager or an entry fee; it does not increase your odds beyond the work it performs.

Open to individuals who may lawfully participate under the laws of their jurisdiction. Void where prohibited or restricted. You are solely responsible for compliance with all applicable local laws, including any rules on contests, sweepstakes, lotteries, or gaming.

The draw is deterministic and reproducible from public inputs (seed = previous block hash, participant addresses, and weights). The in-app “Verify the draw” tool lets anyone replay it and confirm the result.
The chance of finding a block depends on the total Bitcoin network hash rate and the hash rate and duration contributed. Odds are not fixed and are typically very low.
Winnings, if any, are Bitcoin block subsidies and fees paid on-chain directly to the participant’s address. Winners are solely responsible for any applicable taxes.
Apple Inc. is not a sponsor of, and is not involved in, this promotion in any way. Apple bears no responsibility or liability arising from your participation.
